name: sparsew2t CSRC pilot smoke: power check + 1 fold K=3
command: set -o pipefail; O=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; ln -sfn /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/data data; echo '[1/2] power'; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -W ignore scripts/power_check.py --config configs/default.yaml --dataset-config configs/datasets/csrc_pilot.yaml 2>&1 | tee $O/power.log | tail -n 30; echo '[2/2] one fold'; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -W ignore scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/default.yaml --dataset-config configs/datasets/csrc_pilot.yaml --seeds 42 --k 3 --override experiment.device=cpu splits.max_folds=1 --out $O/run 2>&1 | tee $O/run.log | grep -E --line-buffered 'panel T=|supervision|fold 0|progress|Traceback|Error|saved'; grep -A3 'event level' $O/run.log; f=$(find $O/run -name rows.csv | head -1); test -n "$f" || { tail -n 40 $O/run.log; exit 1; }; cp $(dirname $f)/*.csv $O/ && touch $O/DONE
